text: The paper studies whether weak model supervision can elicit the full capabilities of a much stronger model, using pretrained GPT-4-family models on NLP, chess and reward modeling tasks. It reports that strong models naively finetuned on weak-model labels consistently outperform their weak supervisors (weak-to-strong generalization) but remain far from recovering the strong models' full capabilities, and that simple methods help: with a GPT-2-level supervisor and an auxiliary confidence loss, finetuned GPT-4 recovers close to GPT-3.5-level performance on NLP tasks.
title: Weak-to-strong generalization: weak model labels partially elicit strong model capability
